settings.heading: Key features for the professional station

settings.title: Electric positioning
settings.text: Remote-controlled positioning and a dedicated height pedal.

settings.title: Four-cushion design
settings.text: A four-part cushion layout for treatment positioning.

settings.title: Adjustable headrest
settings.text: Crescent and regular headrests support different treatment setups.

settings.title: Prepare the chair
settings.text: Follow the Royal operating manual for installation and electrical connection. Check that the controls are connected as directed.

settings.title: Set the treatment height
settings.text: Use the dedicated height pedal or the controls specified in the manual to set the chair for access and treatment.

settings.title: Position the client supports
settings.text: Adjust the headrest and armrests for the treatment setup, following the operating manual.

settings.title: Adjust the treatment position
settings.text: Use the remote controls to position the chair. Check clearances before moving any powered section.

settings.heading: Safety information
settings.introduction: These reminders do not replace the Royal operating manual.

settings.title: Operating limits
settings.text: Confirm the manufacturer’s load limits, electrical requirements and installation instructions before use.

settings.title: Moving parts
settings.text: Keep hands, cables and objects clear of the base and moving joints before operating the controls.

settings.title: Maintenance
settings.text: Disconnect the power supply before maintenance or servicing. Follow the manufacturer’s cleaning instructions.

settings.title: What is Royal’s height adjustment range?
settings.text: The listed height adjustment range is 17–39 in. (43–99 cm). Confirm the specification for your configuration with Equipro.

settings.title: What electrical connection is required?
settings.text: Confirm the voltage, grounding and installation requirements from the Royal operating manual before connection.

settings.title: Can Royal be used for facials and massage?
settings.text: Royal is described for facials, body treatments, massage and waxing. Select the treatment position using the chair controls.

settings.title: Which upholstery colors are offered?
settings.text: White, black and navy. Contact Equipro to confirm the configuration you need.

settings.title: What controls are supplied?
settings.text: The current product description lists a remote control and dedicated height pedal. Confirm included accessories when ordering.

settings.title: What warranty applies?
settings.text: Contact Equipro for the warranty applicable to your Royal chair and order.

settings.title: How should the armrests and headrests be adjusted?
settings.text: Follow the Royal operating manual for adjustment and removal procedures; confirm optional accessories with Equipro.
